caption: A stick of incense burns in a holder, and the grey ash column lengthens, curls, and finally drops into the tray.

sa.check: A stick of incense burns in a holder.
The glowing point creeps down the stick.
The grey ash above the glowing point lengthens and curls.
The ash breaks and drops into the tray.
Smoke rises from the glowing point.
The lengthening comes first and the dropping follows.

pc.expect: The glowing point only creeps along the stick and the ash behind it only grows; burnt stick does not become fresh incense.
pc.fail: The glowing point moves back the way it came; or the ash turns back into unburnt incense; or the stick grows longer as it burns; or the ash column shortens with nothing breaking off.

pc.expect: The ash column bends downward under its own weight and, when it breaks, falls straight down into the tray, while the smoke rises.
pc.fail: The ash column bends upward; or a broken piece of ash rises or hangs in the air; or the ash falls upward out of the tray; or the smoke sinks and pools around the holder.

pc.expect: The ash builds behind the glowing point and the tray catches what falls from it.
pc.fail: Ash appears in the tray with none falling from the stick; or the stick burns with no ash forming behind the glowing point at all; or the ash grows on the unburnt part ahead of the glowing point; or the smoke leaves a part of the stick that has not burnt.

pc.expect: The ash is a fragile grey column that bends and crumbles, the unburnt stick stays rigid, and the smoke is a fine thread.
pc.fail: The ash stays straight and bright like fresh incense; or the ash bends like rubber and springs back; or the unburnt stick sags; or the smoke holds a fixed rigid shape like a wire.

pc.expect: One stick in one holder; the stick shortens only by burning and the ash goes only into the tray.
pc.fail: A second stick appears already lit; or the stick vanishes while still long; or the glowing point jumps to a new place on the stick; or the ash reattaches to the stick after falling.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The holder, the tray and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The holder changes shape; or the tray changes colour; or items around the holder rearrange.
